title: F0 finance stretch — decisions
note: Product answered checklist 2026-08-05. All decision ids locked. Build via suggested_ship_slices.
invariants: Do not invent a Middo login user
MiddoCashLedger remains the till / cash-in-hand SoT (not bank float)
Bank multi-account is a separate SoT maintained by accounts; admin CRUD of accounts
VAT is inclusive in food price; accounts/P&L must unbundle VAT from middo_rest correctly

vat.effective: always (no historic rate table for now)
vat.storage: per order line / order snapshot at place time
vat.accounts: unbundle VAT from food for middo_rest / tax payable reporting

eps_charges.model: % of transaction by sub-gateway (EPS→bank, EPS→bKash, EPS→Nagad, …)
eps_charges.accounts: fee expense / net bank credit must be recorded

buckets: cash_receivable_kitchen — kitchen holds Middo cash / transfer pending
cash_receivable_riders — rider Due / cash bag until Middo handover
cash_positions.note: Not a single till↔bank teleport; positions board + posts between buckets and into bank accounts

pnl_batches.kitchen_settlement_batches: in_F2 — multi-payable remittance packets (single withdrawals stay as today)

suggested_ship_slices: F0a — VAT 5% inclusive on food: Settings + order snapshot + money tree / middo_rest aware
F0b — Middo bank accounts CRUD (admin) + accounts ledger posts; EPS net + sub-gateway fee %
F0c — Cash positions board (EPS / kitchen recv / rider recv / cash in hand) + accounts posts
F0d — Withdrawal channel (Bank/bKash/Nagad/Cash) + optional attachment on accounts process
F0e — Period P&L + Excel export on cash / bank / VAT / positions
